description: This line plot illustrates the training progress of two distinct accuracy metrics, labeled “Ex1 Accuracy” and “Ex2 Accuracy,” over a sequence of training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” is also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.10 to 0.40, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The “Ex1 Accuracy” is represented by a dark blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.24 at step 0, rising sharply to about 0.39 by step 10,000, and then leveling off near 0.40 for the remainder of the training steps. The “Ex2 Accuracy” is depicted by a teal line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 0.10 at step 0, increasing steadily to about 0.29 by step 10,000, and then continuing to rise more gradually to approximately 0.39 by step 50,000, where it plateaus. Both lines show a general upward trend in accuracy over time, with “Ex1 Accuracy” reaching a higher plateau than “Ex2 Accuracy.”
